name: UniDrop
tagline: AI tools and campus connections for University of Tsukuba students
description:
UniDrop helps University of Tsukuba students navigate campus life with AI assistance, course and graduation planning, a student marketplace, and optional weekly introductions.

For students without a profile photo, Humation provides hand-drawn avatars from a few handpicked seeds, with distinct styles for men and women.

humation.usage: Default profile avatars from handpicked seeds, with distinct styles for men and women
